claims.claim: Classic and reliable Thermocool freezer with strong capacity, long lasting freezing
claims.evidence: No power-on or thermometer test shown; badge confirms brand only.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photo 1 and 2 show rust spots along the base/bottom edge, inconsistent with a unit purchased new only a year ago.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Compressor is sealed and shown only from outside in Photo 2; internal/opening history cannot be seen.
Not shown in any photo; only a warranty logo badge is visible on the unit itself.

risks.risk: Cooling/compressor may not actually work or may be weak
risks.proof: Video of unit plugged in, running, and frost/ice forming inside after 15-20 minutes
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional until cooling is demonstrated

risks.risk: Rust at base may indicate corrosion, age, or past water/condensation damage affecting structural life
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all rust spots and the underside/base
risks.if_unproven: priced as having body corrosion risk, discounted from a rust-free unit

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket may be worn, causing poor sealing and higher power use
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full gasket perimeter with lid closed and open

risks.risk: Cord/plug may be damaged or unsafe
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug pins and full cord length

risks.risk: Interior odor, mold, or past spillage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all interior corners and a video panning the inside

risks.risk: Claimed 'barely used, bought last year' may be false given visible rust, meaning real age/usage could be higher
risks.proof: Photo of receipt with legible date and matching serial number on rating plate
risks.if_unproven: priced as an older/used unit, not as a near-new one

proof_requests: Video of freezer running and reaching cold/frost after 15-20 minutes
Close-up photos of all rust areas and the base
Close-up photo of full door gasket
Close-up photo of power cord and plug
Photo of receipt and warranty card with legible date and serial number matching the rating plate
Close-up of rating plate for model and capacity
response.reason: Item is clearly identified as a Haier Thermocool chest freezer, but cooling performance, true age, and electrical/seal condition are unverified or contradicted by visible rust, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
